subject: visitor
action: Browse ranked and filtered works from the home discovery screen.

subject: authenticated user
action: Resume reading from recent activity while browsing the home discovery screen.

subject: System
action: The home screen must show the centered empty state copy when `works.length === 0`. Otherwise it must render the feed as cards in a 2-column grid on small screens and a 3-column grid on `sm` screens, with every `FeedCard` linking to `/works/{work.id}`. Inside each card, the screen must show the cover image when `coverImageUrl` exists, show `표지 없음` when it does not, and display view and like counts using `formatKoreanCount`, which keeps raw numbers below 10,000 and uses a `만` suffix at 10,000 or above.
condition: When feed data has been loaded for the current filter state.
expectedOutcome: Readers either see a no-results message or a grid of work links with consistent presentation and metric formatting.

subject: System
action: The home discovery screen must derive `sortMode` as `latest` or `popular`, derive `sortBasis` as one of `trending`, `views`, `likes`, or `ctr`, and fall back to `popular` and `trending` for unsupported values. The filter UI must default `genre` to `전체` when no genre is present.
expectedOutcome: The page renders with a valid filter state even when the incoming query string is missing or unsupported.

subject: System
action: `FeedFilters` must render with the current genre and sort state, and changing genre or sort must push a new route that preserves `#weekly-ranking`. On genre change, the route must update the `genre` query. On click `최신`, the route must set `sortMode=latest`, clear `sortBasis`, and jump to `#weekly-ranking`. On click `인기`, the route must set `sortMode=popular` and jump to `#weekly-ranking`.
condition: When the reader changes genre or sort controls on the home screen.
expectedOutcome: The page updates filter state in the URL and returns focus to the weekly ranking section.

subject: System
action: `FeedFilters` must show the ranking-basis select only when `sortMode` is `popular`, and when shown it must update `sortBasis` from the selected supported value.
condition: While `sortMode === popular` on the home screen.
expectedOutcome: Readers can refine popular rankings by basis, and that control is absent in other sort modes.

subject: System
action: When `RecentlyReadSection` has no items, the screen must show the empty copy and the anchor button `작품 둘러보기` that jumps to `#weekly-ranking`.
condition: If a signed-in user has an empty `RecentlyReadSection`.
expectedOutcome: The user is offered a direct path from the empty continuation area to the weekly ranking section.

subject: System
action: The home screen must call `supabase.auth.getUser()` to determine the current user, call `listRecentlyRead(supabase, { userId: user.id, limit: 10 })` only when a `user` exists, and render `RecentlyReadSection` only when `loggedIn` is true.
condition: While the visitor is signed in on `/`.
expectedOutcome: Signed-in users receive a recently read section, and signed-out users do not see that section.
